statement.zh: 每个学习者都有否证它每个主张的开放的序列；无记录固定下一个。被列表所持的世界中否证有界、静止不能被否证且只在那里静止，何时静止不被识；对类的学习是同一学习。
statement.en: Every learner has an open course refuting each of its claims; no record fixes the next value. In a world held by a list the refutations are bounded, coming to rest is unrefuted and happens only there, and when is not registered; learning over classes is the same learning.

claim.zh: 被识的序列 o : Nat → O 是被识的值的序列（例如确定律之轨道的识）；第 t 步之前的记录 record o t（最新在前）；学习者是任意从记录作出的主张 pred : List O → Option O；主张被否证（Refuted）指它主张了一个值而所识的值不同；假设在序列上成立（Holds）指它在任何一步都不被否证。不加前提：对每个序列与每步 t，给出两个不同的值，有两个序列与它在 t 之前记录相同、在 t 分别取这两个值，从该记录作出的主张不在两者上都对（no_record_fixes_next），值可判定时在其中之一被否证（claim_refuted_on_one）；两者都是被列表所持之世界的序列（holdFrom_lasso、no_record_fixes_next_finite）。对每个学习者与移动每个值的 other，对角序列 diagonal pred other x 在每个主张处否证它（diagonal_refutes），所以在它上面学习者不从任何一步起都主张且正确（diagonal_unrested）；它是保留记录之律的识，没有列表持有该律的配置（record_diagonal、diagonal_open）。按否证学习（indexOn、learner：假设 H 依次排列，恰在所持者被否证时移向下一个；值可判定）从不越过成立的假设：H j 成立时指标至多为 j（index_le_of_holds），学习者不在任意晚处被否证（refutations_not_recurring）；越过的每个假设都在记录中某一步被否证（refuted_before）；相同的记录给出相同的假设与主张（learner_through_record）。套索（Lasso o i q：从第 i 步起以周期 q + 1 重复）：确定律的轨道被列表 l 所持时，其每个识都是套索且 i + q + 1 ≤ l.length（lasso_of_held）；每个套索都是被列表所持之世界的识（lasso_realized）。套索假设按对角次序排列（lassos、pairAt、pairAt_place）时：在套索序列上学习者至多被否证 tri (i + q) + q 次、从第 i + q + 1 步起每步主张、不在任意晚处被否证（lasso_learner_bounded），它从某步起每步主张且正确这一点不能被否证（rest_unrefuted，双重否定）；它从某步起每步主张且正确时，序列是套索（lasso_of_rest）；轨道被列表 l 所持时，被否证少于 tri l.length 次、从第 l.length 步起每步主张、不在任意晚处被否证（held_learner_bounded），静止不能被否证（held_rest_unrefuted）；它的对角序列不是套索（diagonal_not_lasso）；有界不降的计数从某步起不变这一点不能被否证（stable_unrefuted）。类 G c 沿对合并（merged）时，G c j 成立则合并枚举上的学习者指标至多为 tri (c + j) + j（merged_bound），而每种合并的学习者在其对角序列上不静止（merged_unrested）。见证：Alternate（false, true, false, …）上学习者被否证两次，从第三步起每步正确（Alternate.index_three、Alternate.rests）。
claim.en: A course o : Nat → O is a sequence of registered values (such as the registration of a determined law's orbit); record o t is its record before step t, latest first; a learner is any claim pred : List O → Option O made from a record; a claim is refuted (Refuted) when it claims a value and the registered value differs; a hypothesis holds on a course (Holds) when it is refuted at no step. With no premise: for every course and step t, given two values, two courses share its record before t and take the one and the other value at t, and a claim made from that record is not right on both (no_record_fixes_next), and with values decided is refuted on one of them (claim_refuted_on_one); both are courses of worlds held by a list (holdFrom_lasso, no_record_fixes_next_finite). For every learner and every other moving each value, the diagonal course diagonal pred other x refutes each of its claims (diagonal_refutes), so on it the learner does not, from any step on, claim at every step and be right (diagonal_unrested); it is the registration of a law keeping its record, whose configurations no list holds (record_diagonal, diagonal_open). Learning by refutation (indexOn, learner: hypotheses H in order, moving on exactly where the one held is refuted; values decided) never passes a hypothesis that holds: where H j holds the index is at most j (index_le_of_holds) and the learner is not refuted at arbitrarily late steps (refutations_not_recurring); every hypothesis passed was refuted on the record at some step (refuted_before); one record gives one hypothesis and one claim (learner_through_record). Lassos (Lasso o i q: repeating from step i with period q + 1): where a determined law's orbit is held by a list l, every registration of it is a lasso with i + q + 1 ≤ l.length (lasso_of_held); every lasso is the registration of a world held by a list (lasso_realized). With the lasso hypotheses in diagonal order (lassos, pairAt, pairAt_place): on a lasso course the learner is refuted at most tri (i + q) + q times, claims at every step from step i + q + 1 on and is not refuted at arbitrarily late steps (lasso_learner_bounded), and that from some step on it claims at every step and is right is unrefuted (rest_unrefuted, a double negation); where from some step on it claims at every step and is right, the course is a lasso (lasso_of_rest); where the orbit is held by a list l it is refuted fewer than tri l.length times, claims at every step from step l.length on and is not refuted at arbitrarily late steps (held_learner_bounded), its coming to rest unrefuted (held_rest_unrefuted); its diagonal course is no lasso (diagonal_not_lasso); that a bounded count that never falls is constant from some step on is unrefuted (stable_unrefuted). With classes G c merged along the pairs (merged), where G c j holds the learner over the merged enumeration has index at most tri (c + j) + j (merged_bound), and the learner over every merging is unrested on its diagonal course (merged_unrested). Witness: on Alternate (false, true, false, …) the learner is refuted twice and right at every step from the third (Alternate.index_three, Alternate.rests).

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。值可判定相等（DecidableEq O）只作为学习者（按否证学习、套索学习者、合并学习者与 diagonal_not_lasso）与 swapTo（另一个值）的条件出现，并只在 claim_refuted_on_one 与 eq_of_not_refuted 的证明中用到；no_record_fixes_next 与 diagonal_refutes、diagonal_unrested、diagonal_open 不用它（逐条见可判定性清点）。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. Decidable equality of values (DecidableEq O) appears only as a condition of the learner (learning by refutation, the lasso learner, the merged learner and diagonal_not_lasso) and of swapTo (another value), and is used only in the proofs of claim_refuted_on_one and eq_of_not_refuted; no_record_fixes_next and diagonal_refutes, diagonal_unrested and diagonal_open do not use it (each is listed in the decidability inventory).

hypotheses.zh: 每条定理的条件写在其中：两个不同的值（no_record_fixes_next）；other 移动每个值（对角）；某个假设成立（index_le_of_holds、refutations_not_recurring）；序列是套索或轨道被列表所持（lasso_learner_bounded、held_learner_bounded）。假设的列表 H 与类 G 由学习之外给出。
hypotheses.en: Each theorem's conditions are written into it: two different values (no_record_fixes_next); other moving every value (the diagonal); some hypothesis holding (index_le_of_holds, refutations_not_recurring); the course being a lasso or the orbit held by a list (lasso_learner_bounded, held_learner_bounded). The hypotheses H and the classes G are supplied from outside the learning.

hypotheses.zh: 静止只以双重否定陈述（rest_unrefuted、held_rest_unrefuted、stable_unrefuted），名称依整合者的规则带“unrefuted”：此处不给出静止之步（并未证明不能给出；P83 给出它：轨道被长 N 的列表所持时，学习者从第 N + (2N − 1)·tri N 步起每步主张且正确，Identification.held_learner_rests，这一步由界给出，学习者的记录不表明它）；“不在任意晚处被否证”是“否证复现”的否定，不是“从某步起不被否证”。
hypotheses.en: Coming to rest is stated only as a double negation (rest_unrefuted, held_rest_unrefuted, stable_unrefuted), the names carrying “unrefuted” under the integrator's rule: the step of rest is not stated here (not shown impossible; P83 states it: where the orbit is held by a list of length N, the learner claims and is right at every step from N + (2N − 1)·tri N on, Identification.held_learner_rests, a step the bound gives and the learner's record does not show); “not refuted at arbitrarily late steps” is the negation of refutations recurring, not “unrefuted from some step on”.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12 问对元层次、人工神经网络、认知与关于学习的智慧解释得多完整；对 AI 的回答（四者都未完成，归纳问题未消解）答：“please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”。AI 读作：完成所提三步，并消解归纳问题。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：归纳被消解为规律而不是被保证；休谟的问题在 no_record_fixes_next；按否证学习是 Gold 意义上的极限识别，静止不被识；元层次是再学习，没有顶层（merged_unrested 的读法）；智慧不是一个完成的学习者。
correspondence.en: On 12 October 2026 Ren asked how completely the meta level, artificial neural networks, cognition and the wisdom about learning are explained; to the AI's answer (none complete, induction undissolved) Ren replied “please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”. The AI reads it as completing the three proposed steps and resolving the problem of induction. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): induction is resolved into laws rather than certified; Hume's problem sits at no_record_fixes_next; learning by refutation is identification in the limit in Gold's sense, its rest unregistered; the meta level is learning again, with no top (the reading of merged_unrested); wisdom is never a completed learner.

detail.zh: 复用 Law.orbit、Law.process、revisits_within（有限多配置之内轨道返回）、unlisted_of_new（每步新的律不被列表所持）、gap_of_le、gap_of_lt、mem_cons_split。增量是把返回读到识上：被列表所持的轨道的识是套索，保留记录之律的识是对角序列。
detail.en: Reuses Law.orbit, Law.process, revisits_within (within finitely many configurations the orbit returns), unlisted_of_new (a law new at every step is held by no list), gap_of_le, gap_of_lt and mem_cons_split. The delta reads return off the registration: the registration of an orbit held by a list is a lasso, and the registration of a law keeping its record is the diagonal course.

output.zh: 有限多配置之内轨道返回；每步新的律不被列表所持。
output.en: Within finitely many configurations the orbit returns; a law new at every step is held by no list.

input.zh: 被列表所持之世界的识是套索；对角序列的世界开放。
input.en: The registration of a world held by a list is a lasso; the diagonal course's world is open.

detail.zh: P49 的 Web.tail_unrefuted（没有模型，有限记录不否证关于其后的主张）是水平历史上的同一规律；这里对任意被识的序列陈述（no_record_fixes_next），并给出它的正面一侧：被列表所持的世界中按否证学习否证有界。
detail.en: P49's Web.tail_unrefuted (without a model no finite record refutes a claim about what follows) is the same law for level histories; here it is stated for every course (no_record_fixes_next), with its positive side: in a world held by a list learning by refutation is refuted a bounded number of times.

output.zh: 主张只经所识的差别被否证；无模型时记录不否证关于其后的主张。
output.en: A claim is refuted only through a registered difference; without a model the record refutes no claim about what follows.

input.zh: 被识的序列上的否证与学习。
input.en: Refutation and learning on a course of registered values.

conditions.zh: 识能分辨值（按否证学习处）。
conditions.en: A registration that tells values apart (for learning by refutation).

detail.zh: 那里记录只在取过之处固定一个动作的结果；这里记录不固定下一个值，套索的返回就是使学习静止的返回。
detail.en: There the record fixes an act's outcome only where taken; here the record fixes no next value, and a lasso's return is the return that lets learning come to rest.

detail.zh: 那里说一个关于何者无关的模型何时正确；这里说从记录选出模型的学习何时静止。
detail.en: There, when a model of what is irrelevant is right; here, when learning that selects a model from the record comes to rest.

detail.zh: 归纳的规律是科学探究的必要关系的一部分；本记录不证明完整核心对科学的不可或缺性。
detail.en: The laws of induction are part of the necessary relations of scientific inquiry; this record does not prove the whole core indispensable to science.

detail.zh: 没有学习者在每个序列上静止：对角序列在每个主张处否证它（diagonal_unrested），套索学习者的对角序列不是套索（diagonal_not_lasso）。
detail.en: No learner rests on every course: the diagonal course refutes each of its claims (diagonal_unrested), and the lasso learner's diagonal course is no lasso (diagonal_not_lasso).

limitations.zh: 一个实际形成持有哪些假设或类、它的识是否分辨值、它的世界是否被列表所持，不推出；界 tri N 粗，不是最优；只陈述确定的、逐值的学习，概率的或近似的学习（PAC）、可数类的一般学习理论、计算的复杂性没有陈述；主要定理是学习理论中已知结果（Putnam 1963 的对角、Gold 1967 与 Putnam 1965 的极限识别、Gold 的枚举法、Kelly 1996）在脊柱上的形式，增量是与识、实验、机制与选择接为一体；读法除理之外是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: Which hypotheses or classes an actual formation holds, whether its registration tells values apart and whether its world is held by a list are not derived; the bound tri N is coarse, not optimal; only determined, value-by-value learning is stated, and probabilistic or approximate learning (PAC), the general theory of countable classes and computational complexity are not; the main theorems are known results of learning theory (Putnam's 1963 diagonal, identification in the limit after Gold 1967 and Putnam 1965, Gold's enumeration method, Kelly 1996) in the spine's form, the delta being their integration with registration, experiment, mechanism and selection; the readings other than 理 are the AI's, pending Ren; contains no ethical predicate.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261013T094743.528770Z）：Becoming.Learning 的 75 项定理全部空依赖，其中含 no_record_fixes_next、claim_refuted_on_one、diagonal_refutes、diagonal_open、index_le_of_holds、refutations_not_recurring、held_learner_bounded、held_rest_unrefuted与 merged_unrested；同一回执覆盖包内 75 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 4518 项定理／6370 项声明审计，22 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 77 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §92；尚无独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 75 theorems of Becoming.Learning all have empty axiom reports, among them no_record_fixes_next, claim_refuted_on_one, diagonal_refutes, diagonal_open, index_le_of_holds, refutations_not_recurring, held_learner_bounded, held_rest_unrefuted and merged_unrested; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §92 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

next_delta.zh: 识不分辨值时（阈下）的学习；概率的读法；与 P71（在其所识之内的识在每一步不完全）的连接；Ren 对“归纳被消解为规律”的判断。
next_delta.en: Learning where registration does not tell values apart (below threshold); a probabilistic reading; the connection with P71 (a registration within what it registers incomplete at every step); Ren's judgment on “induction resolved into laws”.
